SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_receipt_line, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_all, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_all
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class,
 COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.gross_amount - ROUND(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.sale_ts_utc,
        CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) n, SUM(net_amount) net, SUM(gross_amount) gross,
 SUM(CASE WHEN hel_date <> sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch,
 (SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id < 900 AND strftime(r.business_date,'%Y-%m') = strftime(l.sale_date,'%Y-%m')) AS rpt_net_before_returns
FROM l GROUP BY 1, 6 ORDER BY 1
